workarounds.symptom: [Bug] Failed CREATE TABLE leaves table registered on MetaData, retry fails with "already defined" (MySQL/SQLite)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: drop failed table from MetaData on MySQL and SQLite retry. Target files: libs/agno/agno/db/mysql/async_mysql.py, libs/agno/agno/db/mysql/mysql.py, libs/agno/agno/db/postgres/async_postgres.py. Follow-up to #11723 (which fixed this for Postgres). (Ref: https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/11846)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] Neo4jTools returns [] when a query fails, so the agent reads an error as "no results"
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [fix] Surface Neo4jTools errors instead of returning []. Target files: libs/agno/agno/tools/neo4j.py, libs/agno/tests/unit/tools/test_neo4j.py. `Neo4jTools` (`list_labels`, `list_relationship_types`, `get_schema`, `run_cypher_query`) caught all exceptions, logged them, and returned `[]`. Agents could not tell a Cypher/connection failure from a real empty result. (Ref: https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/11724)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] PostgresDb: a failed first CREATE TABLE leaves the table on MetaData, so every retry raises "already defined for this MetaData instance"
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: postgres drop a failed table from MetaData so a retry can create it. Target files: libs/agno/agno/db/postgres/async_postgres.py, libs/agno/agno/db/postgres/postgres.py, libs/agno/tests/unit/db/test_async_postgres.py. `_create_table` builds `Table(table_name, self.metadata, ...)` before running the DDL. When the DDL fails, the handler re-raises but leaves the half-built `Table` on the shared `MetaData`, so the next call raises `InvalidRequestError: Table ... is already defined for this MetaData instance` even after the da... (Ref: https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/11723)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] DaytonaTools fails with daytona 2.0, and the install hint points back to it
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [fix] Pin Daytona extra below 1.0 and hint a supported SDK. Target files: cookbook/91_tools/daytona_tools.py, libs/agno/agno/tools/daytona.py, libs/agno/pyproject.toml. `DaytonaTools` imports `CodeLanguage`, `CreateSandboxFromSnapshotParams`, and `Sandbox` from the `daytona` package root. Daytona SDK 2.0 moved those symbols to `daytona.v0`, so the import raises `ImportError`. The `except ImportError` handler then reports that `daytona` is not installed and recommends `pip install daytona`, which reinstalls 2.x once it is the ... (Ref: https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/11725)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] MCPTools.connect() returns None whether the handshake succeeded or failed
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: report MCPTools.connect() outcome and cleanup on CancelledError. Target files: libs/agno/agno/tools/mcp/mcp.py, libs/agno/tests/unit/tools/test_mcp.py. - `MCPTools.connect()` now returns whether the toolkit ended initialized, so callers can branch without reaching into private state. - Ordinary connect failures are still swallowed (AgentOS / tool-listing paths from #8156). - `asyncio.CancelledError` during connect runs `_safe_cleanup()` and then re-raises. (Ref: https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/11135)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] SQLTools.run_sql swallows fetch errors and returns [], indistinguishable from a real empty result
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: surface SQLTools fetch errors instead of returning []. Target files: libs/agno/agno/tools/sql.py, libs/agno/tests/unit/tools/test_sql.py. run_sql wrapped row fetching in try/except and returned [] on failure, so run_sql_query serialized a failed fetch as '[]', identical to a genuinely empty result. This change removes the swallowing handler so fetch errors propagate to run_sql_query, which already returns an error string. Adds regression tests. . Built with Muse (Aurora) as co-author. (Ref: https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/11680)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] Qdrant.insert ignores batch_size and sends all points in one upsert
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: qdrant honour batch_size when inserting documents. Target files: libs/agno/agno/vectordb/qdrant/qdrant.py, libs/agno/tests/unit/vectordb/test_qdrantdb.py. `Qdrant.insert(..., batch_size=10)` documented the parameter but never read it: every point was collected and sent in a single `client.upsert`, so a large document could exceed the server's request-size limit. (Ref: https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/11722)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] Workspace.read_file rejects a file with exactly max_file_lines lines
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: count real lines in Workspace.read_file so max_file_lines accepts a file with exactly that many lines. Target files: libs/agno/agno/tools/workspace.py, libs/agno/tests/unit/tools/test_workspace.py. `Workspace.read_file()` refuses to return a whole file when it is longer than `max_file_lines`, and it counts lines as `contents.count("\n") + 1`: (Ref: https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/11461)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] FileTools.read_file counts a trailing line separator as an extra line
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [fix] Exclude trailing line separator from FileTools.read_file line count. Target files: libs/agno/agno/tools/file/file.py, libs/agno/tests/unit/tools/test_filetools.py. When reading a file that ends with a trailing line separator (e.g. standard POSIX newline), `contents.split(self.line_separator)` creates an empty trailing element in the split list. This caused `FileTools.read_file` to count an extra line and reject files with exactly `max_file_lines` lines as "file too long". (Ref: https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/11687)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] JSON trace reads ignore limits with page=None or limit=0
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: reject page 0 on /traces and apply limit without page in JSON trace reads. Target files: libs/agno/agno/db/gcs_json/gcs_json_db.py, libs/agno/agno/db/json/json_db.py, libs/agno/agno/os/routers/traces/traces.py. - `GET /traces` rejects `page=0` with `422`, like `/trace_session_stats` and `/traces/search`. Pages are 1-indexed; before, `page=0` returned every trace on `JsonDb`/`GcsJsonDb` and nothing on Redis/Valkey. - `JsonDb` and `GcsJsonDb` `get_traces` / `get_trace_stats`: `limit` without `page` now returns the first `l... (Ref: https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/10816)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] Workflow Step silently serializes RunContext into a string when the executor is a RemoteAgent, corrupting downstream agent's run_context
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: send remote run fields in a shape AgentOS parses. Target files: libs/agno/agno/agent/remote.py, libs/agno/agno/client/os.py, libs/agno/agno/os/utils.py. A `RemoteAgent` run as a workflow Step sent the step's `RunContext` over HTTP. It arrived downstream as a string and crashed the run with `'str' object has no attribute 'dependencies'`. Even past that, every `RemoteAgent` step failed afterwards on `'RemoteAgent' object has no attribute 'scrub_run_output_for_storage'`. (Ref: https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/11587)

workarounds.symptom: RunOutput.from_dict() does not restore status to RunStatus enum (breaks SSE resume-stream replay)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [fix] Restore RunStatus on Team and Workflow run deserialization. Target files: libs/agno/agno/run/team.py, libs/agno/agno/run/workflow.py, libs/agno/tests/unit/run/test_run_output_status.py. `to_dict()` serializes the run status as its string value, and `RunOutput.from_dict()` has been coercing it back to the `RunStatus` enum since the sandbox work landed (`#11028`). `TeamRunOutput.from_dict()` and `WorkflowRunOutput.from_dict()` were left out, so every team or workflow run reloaded from storage — database adapters (`agno/db... (Ref: https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/11424)

(Ref: https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/11397)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] Async YouTube Knowledge ingestion fails on the name argument
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: accept the name argument in YouTubeReader.async_read. Target files: libs/agno/agno/knowledge/reader/youtube_reader.py, libs/agno/tests/unit/reader/test_youtube_reader.py. `YouTubeReader.async_read()` accepted only `url`, while the synchronous `YouTubeReader.read()` accepts an optional `name` and uses it as the document name. `Knowledge._aload_from_url()` (the async URL path in `libs/agno/agno/knowledge/knowledge.py`) calls `await reader.async_read(content.url, name=name)`, so every async YouTube URL ingestion stopped at ... (Ref: https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/11417)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] ApifyTools registers no Actors with apify-client 3.x
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: support apify-client 3.x response models in ApifyTools. Target files: libs/agno/agno/tools/apify.py, libs/agno/tests/unit/tools/test_apify.py. `ApifyTools` read apify-client responses as dicts. apify-client 3.x returns Pydantic models instead, so `actor.get("id")` raised `AttributeError` and no Actor got registered on a fresh `agno[apify]` install. (Ref: https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/11407)
